# pvecli node evacuate

Move every guest off a node before maintenance.

Same as: pvecli cluster guests migrate TARGET --node NODE

```text
pvecli node evacuate NODE TARGET [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node to empty. |
| `TARGET` | Node receiving its guests. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--with-local-disks` | Copy local disks during live migrations. |
| `--max-workers N` | Migrations running at the same time. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli node evacuate pve1 pve2
pvecli node evacuate pve1 pve2 --with-local-disks --max-workers 2
```
